content: We consider two performance metrics for all scenarios: (1) accuracy over the 150 intents, and (2) recall on out-of-scope queries. We use recall to evaluate out-of-scope since we are more interested in cases where such queries are predicted as in-scope, as this would mean a system gives the user a response that is completely wrong. Precision errors are less problematic as the fallback response will prompt the user to try again, or inform the user of the system's scope of supported domains.
